paragraphs: In Chullin 38a: Ravina said, “Sama bar Chilkai told me: Bar Avuvram’s father raised a difficulty on it,” etc.
In Zevachim 103a he raised an objection to Ravina: “Is a convert not a person?”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Zevachim 103a does contain the objection “Is a convert not a person?” (אטו גר לאו איש הוא), attributed to Rav Simai bar Chilkai. This resolves the reviewer’s nonmatch based on the different wording אינש; Hyman supplies Sama, preserved as a name-form difference. The Chullin 38a chain remains separate.

The complete Chullin 38a paragraph has Sama bar Chilkai reporting the objection of Bar Avuvram’s father, with an alternative “brother” reading. The complete Zevachim 103a paragraph has Rav Simai bar Chilkai asking Ravina “Is a convert not a person?” using איש, beside Hyman’s Sama and אינש. The name and wording differences are retained.
